### Is foreign direct investment (FDI) associated with life expectancy across countries?

```{r}
library(WDI)
library(tidyverse)

wdi_variables <- WDIsearch()

write_csv(wdi_variables, "WDI_variables.csv")
```

```{r}
wdi_data <- WDI(
  country = "all",
  indicator = c("BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS", "SP.DYN.LE00.IN"),
  start = 2023,
  end = 2023
)

head(wdi_data)
names(wdi_data)
dim(wdi_data)
```

```{r}
clean_wdi <- wdi_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS),
         !is.na(SP.DYN.LE00.IN),
         !is.na(iso3c))

head(clean_wdi)
dim(clean_wdi)
```

The following code used help from r-graph-gallery.com

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# Give variables simpler names and add continents
graph_data <- clean_wdi %>%
  rename(
    FDI = BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS,
    Life_Expectancy = SP.DYN.LE00.IN
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Continent = countrycode(iso3c, "iso3c", "continent")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Continent))

# Create the interactive app
ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel("FDI vs. Life Expectancy (2023)"),

  sliderInput(
    "fdi_range",
    "Select FDI Range (% of GDP):",
    min = floor(min(graph_data$FDI)),
    max = ceiling(max(graph_data$FDI)),
    value = c(0, 10)
  ),

  plotlyOutput("scatterplot")
)

server <- function(input, output) {

  output$scatterplot <- renderPlotly({

    filtered_data <- graph_data %>%
      filter(
        FDI >= input$fdi_range[1],
        FDI <= input$fdi_range[2]
      )

    p <- ggplot(
      filtered_data,
      aes(
        x = FDI,
        y = Life_Expectancy,
        color = Continent,
        text = paste0(
          "Country: ", country,
          "<br>Continent: ", Continent,
          "<br>FDI: ", round(FDI, 2), "% of GDP",
          "<br>Life Expectancy: ",
          round(Life_Expectancy, 1), " years"
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(size = 2.5) +
      geom_smooth(
        aes(group = 1),
        method = "lm",
        se = FALSE,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Foreign Direct Investment vs. Life Expectancy (2023)",
        x = "FDI Net Inflows (% of GDP)",
        y = "Life Expectancy (Years)",
        color = "Continent"
      )

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
library(countrycode)

graph_data <- graph_data %>%
  mutate(
    Continent = countrycode(iso3c, "iso3c", "continent")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Continent))
```

The outcome: - Our 2023 scatterplot suggests a weak or nonexistent linear relationship between foreign direct investment and life expectancy across countries. Most observations are concentrated between 0% and 5% FDI relative to GDP, yet life expectancy varies considerably within this range. This suggests that FDI alone may not explain differences in life expectancy.
